UP-DEF-01-budget-ignored.behavior: --budget is accepted and silently ignored. cli.prompts calls prompt_catalog(refs, parse, json_out, limit, line_cap) and never passes budget, so bare `prompts`, `--budget 0` and `--budget 50` all print byte-identical output.
UP-DEF-01-budget-ignored.reaches_this_tree: no. The catalog path is not adopted under D-08, and prompt_command.py passes budget into PromptOpts on both the explicit and the default path.
UP-DEF-01-budget-ignored.surface: sxr prompts --budget N, with no session id, --file or --latest

UP-DEF-02-limit-changes-unit.behavior: -n silently changes unit from prompt records to session rows: with two human sessions in scope, -n 1 prints one session row and '# +1 more', -n 2 prints both. A negative -n prints zero rows and exits 0.
UP-DEF-02-limit-changes-unit.reaches_this_tree: no. -n counts prompt records on every path here, and PAR-tools-typer-limit's 'may a limit change unit' question stays open rather than answered by adoption.
UP-DEF-02-limit-changes-unit.surface: sxr prompts -n N, with no session id, --file or --latest

2026-09-11 SXR-CLI-05.detail: Every 'before' cell was re-read against the slice-05 baseline source and still described it: src/sxr/cli.py:277 read `sessions if arg is None and grep_ else resolve(arg, sessions)`, so a nonempty --grep with no selector searched every session in scope while `@1 --grep` searched one, an empty --grep string fell back to newest, and views_info.cmds_view trimmed command text at SXR_LINE_LIMIT (200). No disposition class changed; all four rows already pointed at this task. Clauses closed here: scope independent of the filter and --all-sessions as the explicit scope (CMD-cmds-typer, PAR-cmds-typer-arg, PAR-cmds-typer-grep_, EXTRA-044), plus the primer/help/README migration named in the compatibility cells. One unlisted facet of the same defect was found while reading and fixed with it: the filter also changed the exit contract, so an empty --since window exited 1 with --grep and 2 without; both are now 2, as for every other read command. Clauses left for later slices, unclosed and unweakened: complete call text by default and --events-json (CMD-cmds-typer), -F/--fixed for literal matching (PAR-cmds-typer-grep_), and the --json duplicate-record clause, which belongs to SXR-CLI-06.
